# Iowa PBS Phenomena

> > Outdoor science education resources for young learners exploring winter phenomena across Iowa.

Iowa PBS Phenomena is an educational initiative that brings outdoor science learning to elementary students through seasonal exploration. The program features hands-on nature experiences at locations throughout Iowa including Dubuque, Orange City, Roland, Pleasant Hill, and Des Moines, with support from educators like Jared McGovern and partners such as Wanderwood Gardens.

- [Outdoor Phenomena for Young Learners](https://phenomena.iowapbs.org/): Winter outdoor science education program for young learners by Iowa PBS
